numerical_errors: The _surjective_fp_kernel method incorrectly computes kernel generators using self.invert(r) for relators r of the codomain. Since relators are identity in the codomain, invert returns the domain identity, resulting in an empty kernel.
The method fails to include domain relators and domain generators that map to codomain identity in the kernel generators.
missing_cases: Domain relators must be included as kernel generators (they are trivial in the domain but define the kernel presentation)
Domain generators that map to codomain identity must be included as kernel generators
Preimages of codomain relators must be computed as products of preimages of constituent generators, not via invert() on the whole relator
actionable_fixes: In _surjective_fp_kernel, add domain relators to kernel_gens: iterate over self.domain.relators and append each to kernel_gens

Replace the loop that calls self.invert(r) on codomain relators with logic that computes preimage as product of generator preimages: for each (symbol, exp) in r.array_form, find the corresponding codomain generator, call self.invert(gen), and multiply into the preimage word raised to exp
Add a loop to include domain generators that map to identity: for g in self.domain.generators, if self(g).is_identity, append g to kernel_gens
Remove the 'if not preimage.is_identity' check when adding preimages, as even trivial-looking preimages may be needed for the kernel presentation
